scope: bounded independent vehicle/image correspondence feasibility; no phase alignment or inference
sequence: Inventory and summarize first whole small entry; inspect raw image-coordinate geometry and distinctive classes without consulting predictions.
Compare trajectory/image geometry before identity or clock claims; inspect a bounded coarse selection of context frames if needed.
Only if defensible identities emerge, reserve different vehicles/times for a frozen independent consistency check before estimating clock stability.
If correspondences cannot be established, retain unmatched observations and state precisely why clock/paired metrics remain unavailable.
clock_estimation_eligibility: multiple unambiguous same-car or same-exposure correspondences; geometric/identity ambiguities explicitly excluded
drift_validation: requires independent supported correspondences at separated times; no drift extrapolation from a short local match
